dedupe_keys.name: gegeneraliseerd vlakbestand van de gemeentegrenzen van nederland op basis van kustlijn grens

description: Gegeneraliseerd vlakbestand van de gemeentegrenzen van Nederland, op basis van kustlijn grens is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atlas.brabant.nl. Gegeneraliseerde kaart van Nederland 2023, bevat de gemeentegrenzen (tussen land en (groot) water), geschikt voor het gebruik op de schalen 1: 750.000 en 1: 1.000.000 (en op papierformaat A3). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Generalised flat file of the municipal borders of the Netherlands, based on coastline border" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2023-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
